name: Habitat
description: Habitat with code, skills, tools, phenomena and supervisor-owned remaining-time/self-scheduled sleep services.
notes: S015-S018 (ADR-0022/0024). Executable capabilities use fresh rootless containers: no network, read-only world/root and workspace-only writes. tools.create pins sandbox-validated entry source with explicit experiment opt-in. world.observe/act/advance are supervisor services with separate phenomena configuration; their rules and private state are outside sandbox mounts. No service grants host privileges. models.ask is excluded; the container image has the Python standard library only. time.remaining reports original active budget; time.sleep requires self-scheduled-v1 and never widens deadlines. New-run file/memory lineage is an operator-only Simulation action.
